title: The Economy Beneath the Headlines: Evidence of Weak Underlying Demand and Household Purchasing Power
editorial_thesis: Headline nominal sales and aggregate market strength can obscure stagnant real earnings, weakening labor growth and rising energy expenses.

sources.title: Nominal Gains, Real Strain: Fall in Real Retail Sales Means Weaker Q2 GDP
findings: Positive nominal retail sales can coexist with negative inflation-adjusted spending

methodology: Separate nominal and inflation-adjusted growth; identify control-group changes and revisions; cite dates and sources. Sources may use different periods and cannot be directly summed.
limitations: These reports document underlying economic weakness and limitations of headline interpretation; they do not independently establish that official data were falsified or prove intentional SPY price manipulation.
